blocks.text: Day 4 · The Cotacachi-Cayapas Ecological Reserve, created in 1968 and covering some 243,600 hectares from about 35 m to 4,939 m at the summit of Cotacachi, with the condor as its emblem: a walk along the rim of Cuicocha Crater Lake and a boat ride. Then the El Ángel Reserve, with its endemic frailejones and one of the few Polylepis forests in the world; after dinner, a short torchlit walk among the ancient trees. Overnight at Polylepis Lodge. (B, D)

blocks.text: Day 5 · A walk of about 3 hours in the El Ángel Ecological Reserve (15,715 ha), where giant frailejones, up to 6 m tall, cover most of the páramo; look for condors, Andean caracaras and gulls, blue-winged teals, foxes and deer. Transfer to a beautiful historic hacienda. Overnight at Hacienda Cusín. (B)
